summary: The release's docs:tools generator cannot read the private tool catalog with the extension publishable key. Its authenticated Management API fallback calls the Supabase CLI, which is absent from this host's PATH. docs:tools warns and exits zero, but the later strict tool-drift and migration checks will fail closed if their private reads also cannot use an authenticated path.
observed_evidence: tmp/release-logs/latest.log records 401 / 42501 permission denied on tool.binding for the publishable read, then spawnSync supabase ENOENT for the Management API fallback.

scripts/_supabase-management.ts calls the supabase executable with a SELECT-only query and resolves MATRX_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF from env files; that named key is present in .env.production and .env.development.

supabase is absent from PATH and from this repo's and sibling aidream's node_modules/.bin. The authenticated Supabase MCP tool is available to the agent, but its session is not a shell credential or CLI executable.
least_privilege_remedy: Keep tool.binding, tool.definition, tool.surface_defaults, and the migration ledger private to browser roles. The concrete host path is the existing SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN key in sibling aidream/.env, consumed only inside the build-time read helper at point of use, to call the official Supabase Management API POST /v1/projects/{ref}/database/query with read_only=true and fixed SELECT statements. Validate this token's database_read permission and the endpoint response shape with one coordinator-owned read before changing the helper. Do not copy the token to extension env files, include it in a WXT build environment, grant anon SELECT, or use a service-role key in the extension. The authenticated MCP can independently cross-check the read, but its OAuth session is not a shell token.

further_discovery.local_access: ../aidream/.env has a SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN key (name/presence inspected only); this shell has no SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, and no supabase or psql executable was found in PATH or the checked standard/repo locations. ~/.supabase contains only telemetry.json, so an existing CLI login profile was not found.
further_discovery.helper_provenance: scripts/_supabase-management.ts was introduced in commit 50ce4d4 on 2026-09-13. It assumes a Supabase CLI db query subcommand with --linked, --project-ref, --output json, and --workdir. The Supabase CLI source documents --project-ref as a TypeScript CLI-only divergence for db query; this host has no CLI binary, so exact invocation and output shape are unverified here.
further_discovery.canonical_project: Local database contracts identify https://db.matrxserver.com as the platform Data API URL and brsgrqvjdzwihsvnfqkf as its Supabase Management API project ref. The build helper's named MATRX_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF key is present in .env.production and .env.development.

limitations: No credential values were inspected or printed, and no CLI install, SQL, test, build, or database network request was performed.
The existing token's database_read permission and Management API response shape are unverified; a failed authenticated read must remain a strict-gate failure.
Actual strict drift/migration outcomes are pending the coordinator's guarded rerun; package-twins was the first current blocking gate.
next_action: Coordinator should validate one fixed SELECT through the official read_only Management API endpoint using aidream's existing token at point of use, then route the three build-time catalog/ledger readers through that authenticated helper and rerun the exact release candidate's strict gates.
